content.comment_body: Good morning, is it possible to access the SD card of the [product_name] directly from the internet or intranet using telnet or FTP?
Hello [user_name], welcome to the forum. As far as I know, direct access is not possible, only via [product_name].

My goal is to modify the custom web server page without repeatedly uploading it. But if direct access isn't available, you have to use [product_name]. By the way, [product_name] works fine through VPN, but [product_name] does not. Any advice? Thank you.
Several users in the forum are experiencing VPN issues with the extended web server. It might be best to open a support ticket.

analysis.insight_summary: Forum participants want a way to directly access and update the SD card in the [product_name] over the internet or intranet, to simplify the management of custom web server pages. The current requirements to upload changes via [product_name] are viewed as cumbersome. Additionally, challenges with using [product_name] over VPN hinder remote updates.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to have straightforward internet/intranet access to the SD card of the [product_name], ensuring efficient and remote management of custom web pages, especially when using VPN connections.
